notice: Geometry-only ranking; lower is more similar, not higher confidence. RGB, Lab, forehead brightness and cosmetic color changes are not used for ranking or pair gates. Frame status/errors retain extraction hand/clipping checks. Landmark shape cannot establish that two frames show the same person. Treatment timing, identity and unobstructed ROI placement require human review. Limits and score weights are experimental.

settings.shape_rms_definition: RMS distance after centering, unit RMS radius normalization, and proper rotation
settings.expression_units: pixel distances divided by face width in pixels
